mapper.select: SELECT application_type AS applicationType, version AS version, update_url AS updateUrl, change_content AS changeContent, is_manual AS isManual, mani_url AS maniUrl FROM t_version WHERE type = "1" AND status = "2"
SELECT v.version AS version, v.update_url AS update_url, g.code AS code FROM t_version v, t_game g WHERE v.game_id = g.game_id AND g.game_id = #{gameId}
SELECT version AS version, update_url AS updateUrl, change_content AS changeContent, mani_url AS maniUrl, is_manual AS isManual FROM t_version WHERE type = "2" AND status = "2"

SELECT game_id as gameId, version AS version, update_url AS updateUrl, change_content AS changeContent, mani_url AS maniUrl, is_manual AS isManual FROM t_version WHERE type = "3" AND status = "2" AND game_id = #{gameId}
